summary: Completed comprehensive testing of TheLiveVision desktop layout and typography fixes. Tested desktop 1920px, 1440px, and mobile 375px layouts with focus on header structure, typography, navigation, and responsive design.

ui_bugs.issue: Logo and theme toggle are centered instead of positioned left/right respectively
ui_bugs.details: On mobile 375px, logo should be positioned left and theme toggle should be positioned right, but both appear centered due to nav-container justify-content: center

design_issues.issue: Header layout doesn't follow mobile design requirements
design_issues.details: Mobile header should have logo left, theme toggle right, but current CSS centers all elements

passed_tests: Desktop 1920px: Header structure with logo left, tabs center, theme toggle right ✅
Desktop 1440px: All header elements visible without truncation ✅
Desktop 1440px: Hero title maintains large size (72px) ✅
Mobile 375px: Bottom navigation visible and functional ✅
Mobile 375px: Filter accordion with CTA styling (background, border, shadow) ✅
Mobile 375px: Theme toggle has pill style (20px border-radius) ✅
Theme toggle functionality works on all screen sizes ✅
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix mobile header layout: Logo should be positioned left and theme toggle should be positioned right on mobile (375px). Current CSS centers both elements due to nav-container justify-content: center. Need mobile-specific CSS to override this behavior.
